name: scry
description: SessionStart checks that tell an agent session the true state of the world and establish that repository Markdown is untrusted historical material. Also installs two PreToolUse hooks that deny a tool call: one denies any subagent dispatch that names no model (a blank model silently inherits the session's, which is how a week of premium allowance can go in one session), and one denies a first attempt at an expensive Elixir force-rebuild. Plus an advisory on first contact with a large, actively-worked source file. Available on demand via /scry.
